title: Counterexamples to the site-percolation analogues of the Easo-Severo-Tassion cutset theorems
summary: Easo, Severo and Tassion [EST25] proved two theorems about minimal edge cutsets in infinite graphs: that non-triviality of the uniform critical percolation parameter is equivalent to exponential growth of the number of minimal edge cutsets of size n separating a vertex from infinity, and that uniform transience is an alternative sufficient assumption.
